category: Chinese agent platform / RAG knowledge base

free_tier.stated: Advertised as '文件存储和处理不限量' (file storage and processing unlimited) on the shared-storage path; documented default is 100 knowledge bases x 800 files each = 80,000 files. PDF up to 500 MB / 3,000 pages per file on one endpoint; txt 10 MB, docx/doc/ppt/pptx 50 MB on the ingestion path.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: No egress fee on platform-hosted knowledge files.

interface_detail: REST (Qianfan API: upload-to-knowledge-base, create dataset); the BOS-backed path is the only one with a real quota story
tooling: Baidu Qianfan SDK / plain REST; BOS S3-like API for the source-import path
chaining: 100 KBs x 800 files = 80,000 files per account on shared storage; 'unlimited' only on the BOS/BES enterprise path, which means paying for BOS. That collapses to BOS pricing, which is out of scope.
limits_note: per-object-cap 500 MB (PDF), 50 MB (other docs), 10 MB (txt). BOS-backed import is the documented route to '大规模数据' (large-scale data).

identity_cost.detail: a Baidu account registered with a mobile number; Baidu's help centre lists Baidu public cloud among the product lines that accept a mobile number from outside mainland China and states that EU member-state numbers are not supported; whether the Qianfan console accepts an account registered that way is unverified behind a sign-up
identity_cost.country: CN, or a country on the Baidu overseas registration list (no EU member state)

reliability_note: The 'unlimited' claim is 2024 marketing for the enterprise RAG tier and does not survive contact with the docs: the same help centre says the shared-storage path 'supports 小规模文件导入' (small-scale import), and the unlimited path runs through user-owned BOS which is billed. Baidu Cloud registration requires a phone number. Treat as a documented-name entry, not a qualifying provider.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
